items: Ecto-token, OR 10 Ecto-Tokens and coins to travel by Charter Ship (20)
3 colours of dyes. Which you'll need is random. To be prepared, bring 3 red/blue/yellow dyes
Ecto-token, OR 25 Ecto-Tokens and coins to travel by Charter Ship (31)

st.t: Enter Port Phasmatys.
i: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship (2)

st.t: Talk to Velorina in east Port Phasmatys.
s: Yes, I do. It is a very sad story.

st.t: Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus.
Return to Velorina in east Port Phasmatys and ask where the woman can be found.
s: Do you know where this woman can be found?

i: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship (4)

st.t: Talk to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Use the nettle tea on the porcelain cup.
Use the bucket of milk on the porcelain cup.
Talk to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Talk to the Old Crone and offer to help.
s: You are doing so much for me - is there anything I can do for you?
I am afraid I have lost the boat you gave to me.

st.t: Use the silk on the model ship.
Attempt to search the chest in the east of the hull of the ship west of Port Phasmatys. A giant lobster will spawn you need to kill.
Kill the Giant Lobster.
Search the chest in the east of the hull again.
Go up the ladder in the ship west of Port Phasmatys.
Go up to the mast of the ship.

Wait for the wind speed at the top right to drop to low, then search the mast repeatedly until you know all three colours: top half, bottom half and skull emblem. Note them down. Mixes: red + yellow = orange, red + blue = purple, blue + yellow = green.
Dye the top of the model ship's flag to match the real ship.
Dye the bottom of the model ship's flag to match the real ship.
Dye the skull of the model ship's flag to match the real ship.
Go to the main deck of the ship.
Talk to the Old Man with the model ship to get a key.
Use the key on the chest in the Captain's Room, then search it.
Go to the north-west side of the deck and cross the gangplank onto the rocks.
Jump across the rocks to the chest and search it for a map piece.
Use the map pieces together.
Enter Port Phasmatys. The boat trip costs 25 ecto-tokens, or 10 if you have a Ring of Charos (a).
i: Ecto-token, or travel by Charter Ship and 25 ecto-tokens (27, or 12 with a Ring of Charos (a))

st.t: Talk to the Ghost captain at the rowing boat on the docks and travel to Dragontooth Island. It costs 25 ecto-tokens, or 10 with a Ring of Charos (a) equipped, using the Charm option.
i: Ecto-token (25, or 10 with a Ring of Charos (a))

st.t: Stand just west of the Statue of Saradomin, then walk 6 steps south, 8 east, 2 north, 4 east and 22 south. Dig with your spade on the only square with no grass for the book.
Return to Port Phasmatys with the Ghost Captain.

i: 3 colours of dyes. Which you'll need is random. To be prepared, bring 3 red/blue/yellow dyes
Ecto-tokens (27, or 12 with a Ring of Charos (a))

st.t: Enter Port Phasmatys and talk to Ak-Haranu on the docks, just east of the pub.
s: Okay, wait here - I'll get you your bow.

st.t: Talk to Robin in the Port Phasmatys pub. Keep playing runedraw until he agrees to sign your bow.
s: Yes, I'll give you a game.

st.t: Bring the signed bow to Ak-Haranu.
Talk to the Ghost Innkeeper in the Port Phasmatys pub.
s: Do you have any jobs I can do?

st.t: Use a bucket of slime on the bedsheets.
Wear the bedsheet and talk to Gravingas, the ghost protesting with a sign just inside Port Phasmatys' north gate.
s: After hearing Velorina's story I will be happy to help out.

st.t: Alternate talking with the ghost villagers until you have 10 signatures.
Bring the petition to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus. He drops a bone key: pick it up.
Go upstairs at the Ectofuntus.
Use the key on the south room's door.
Search the coffin.
Bring the items to the Old Crone east of the Slayer Tower.
Talk to Necrovarus at the Ectofuntus.
s: Let any ghost who so wishes pass on into the next world.

st.t: Talk to Velorina in east Port Phasmatys to finish!
